closure_proof_model.ANNUAL_CONSOLIDATION: PROVEN: P6 is the annual consolidation in the post-2017 regime.
closure_proof_model.VALID_ANNUAL_SUBMISSION: PARTIAL: the official receipt surface exposes period, Situação, receipt number, processing/transmission timestamps, rectifying-declaration indicator, and MAVS, but pinned evidence does not define which status values constitute a valid submission.
closure_proof_model.CURRENTLY_EFFECTIVE_DECLARATION: NOT_PROVEN: the receipt/status surface exists, but no pinned official rule says that its displayed row is the current/latest effective declaration when retifications or supersessions exist.
closure_proof_model.RECTIFICATION_POSSIBLE: PROVEN: an authorized sixth-bimester rectification path exists.
closure_proof_model.SOURCE_FINAL_LOCKED_STATE: NOT_PROVEN_AND_NOT_REQUIRED: no explicit immutable lock concept was located; processing success or Retificadora = Não must not be treated as immutable finality.
closure_proof_model.OFFICIAL_SIOPE_TRANSMISSION_RECEIPT_SURF: PROVEN_EXISTS_WITH_ANNUAL_2025_STATUS_SCHEMA: operational surface exposes 2025 - Anual rows and transmission/processing/rectification/MAVS columns; Limeira-specific row and effective-version selection semantics are not pinned.

historical_reconciliation.2016: REPOSITORY_CONVENTION: P1 treated as annual/closed without a pinned receipt, deadline, status flag, supersession, or lock proof.
historical_reconciliation.2017_2020: REPOSITORY_CONVENTION: P6 period semantics and historical pipeline treatment; no independently pinned finality state.
historical_reconciliation.2021_2024: REPOSITORY_CONVENTION: P6 period semantics and successful historical pipeline products; no independently pinned finality state.
historical_reconciliation.2025: P6 annual consolidation is proven, but the current proof standard requires an explicit effective-declaration rule and matching observation.
historical_reconciliation.policy: Do not retroactively demote 2016-2024, do not inherit their proof gap, and do not equate annual period semantics with current effectiveness.
